description: Source code defining a Chroma vector store class with methods for adding, deleting, and searching vectors, as well as creating instances from texts or documents. It integrates with the chromadb library and langchain components.

classes.name: Chroma
classes.description: A class extending VectorStore that interfaces with the chromadb library to store and retrieve vectors, supporting operations like add, delete, search, and creation from texts or documents.

methods.name: addDocuments
methods.description: Adds documents to the Chroma database by converting them to vectors using embeddings.

methods.name: ensureCollection
methods.description: Ensures that a collection exists in the database, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: addVectors
methods.description: Adds vectors to the database associated with documents.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes documents from the database by IDs or filter.

methods.name: similaritySearchVectorWithScore
methods.description: Performs a similarity search with a query vector, returning documents with scores.

methods.name: fromTexts
methods.description: Creates a Chroma instance from an array of text strings.

methods.name: fromDocuments
methods.description: Creates a Chroma instance from an array of Document objects.

methods.name: fromExistingCollection
methods.description: Creates a Chroma instance from an existing collection.
